about: Thin class: shared verbs only, reviewed by hand; the rest stays on chemlab call.

why_thin.wtw_oxitopi: the BOD workflow is manual bottle preparation on six independent measuring heads; no method or calibration object
why_thin.inert_puresolvmd: solvent dispensing is a manual valve, needle and regulator procedure per column; no run or measurement
why_thin.vaisala_dmt152: a transmitter: installation, cap and analog-output configuration and one measurement query; no set point or run
why_thin.cem_libertyblue: the twin exposes power, cover, clamp, start / stop and one synthesis query; no reactor verbs exist
why_thin.cytiva_ktaoligosynt: the twin exposes power, clamp, start / stop and one synthesis query; no reactor verbs exist

unsupported.ack: no alarm acknowledge (the heads show warnings on their displays)

start: a BOD run lasts days: start returns at once; follow the head with `result --head hN` or `chemlab read`
method: head settings (duration_days, unit, sample_volume_m3) per head: method --head h1 duration_days=5 unit=mg/l

unsupported.power: no mains switch for agents (the vacuum pump is `chemlab call inert_puresolvmd pump.set`)
unsupported.method: no method: dispensing is a manual valve procedure
unsupported.start: no run: dispense with valve.turn / needle.set / regulator.set per channel (`chemlab call`)
unsupported.result: no measurement (water.measure is not supported by this twin)

alternatives.start: chemlab describe inert_puresolvmd (flask.attach, valve.turn, needle.set per channel)

unsupported.method: no method (settings.configure and output.configure are its own capabilities)
unsupported.start: a continuous transmitter: it measures whenever it is powered
unsupported.stop: a continuous transmitter: switch it off

power: switches the 24 V supply (the transmitter takes 10-35 V; the contract example is 24 V)
result: one SEND reading: dew point (tdf_k), ppm and mg/kg

unsupported.method: the synthesis queue and kinetics are set up by the lab (host)
the synthesis method and kinetics are set up by the lab (host)
